prompt: A counter panel has plus and minus buttons and a label. Complete the listeners so plus adds 1 and minus subtracts 1 but never drops the count below 0.
explanation: Each button gets its own ActionListener, and both listeners share the panel's int field -- the panel object holds the state, the label is just a view of it. Guarding the decrement with an if keeps the model valid no matter how often minus is clicked. Converting the int with String.valueOf before setText is the usual way to display numeric state.
hints: Keep the running total in the value field; the label only displays it.
In onMinus, only decrement when value is greater than 0, then update the label either way.
count.setText(String.valueOf(value)) turns the int into label text.
